name: Drutopia People
description: Config-only Features module that ships a People (Person) content type, its fields, form/view displays, a Search API-backed people listing view, a content-by-author view, pathauto patterns, a people_type taxonomy vocabulary, and role permission grants; part of the Drutopia distribution.
project_description: Drutopia People is a base feature (Features bundle 'drutopia') of the Drutopia distribution. It is a config-only module: it ships no PHP beyond a small .install file, and no routes, services, hooks, or permissions of its own. Installing it imports a People (machine name 'people') node type for profile pages of staff, volunteers and contributors, its fields (title/Name, required Summary, body, Bio paragraphs, media image, position/job title, People type term, Topics terms, meta tags), form and view displays (card, simple_card, small_card, teaser, full, default, search_index), a Search API 'people' index on the database server, a Search API-backed 'people' listing view (page at /people, grouped by People type), a 'content_by_author' view keyed off a field_authors reference, pathauto URL patterns, a 'people_type' taxonomy vocabulary, an 'Add person' action link, and config actions that grant people permissions to the Drutopia contributor/editor/manager roles. The only PHP is drutopia_people.install, whose update hook 8201 installs the views_plain dependency. Installed here as a dev checkout (info.yml has no version line); the version directory tracks the 2.0.x dev branch. It carries the full Drutopia dependency chain (drutopia_core/seo plus ds, field_group, paragraphs, pathauto, metatag, search_api, focal_point, entity_reference_revisions, and more) and is normally installed through the distribution rather than standalone.
